# Version-2 covariance-lag graph-dynamics pilot

This is a full prespecified pilot, not a reduced smoke experiment.
The legacy estimator is retained as a matched benchmark.

  "protocol_version": "dynamic-v2.0-pilot",
  "seed": 20260804,

    160,

    560
  ],

  "stride": 20,

  "n_seeds_per_graph": 20,
  "bootstrap_replicates": 2000,
  "graphs": [
    "ring",
    "small_world",
    "modular",
    "scale_free"
  ],
  "models": [
    "graph_commuting_ou",

  "output_dir": "results/dynamic_pilot"
}
